'''July 2000 Austin tournament (15 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin, TX on 15 July 2000. [[Jack Bauer]] won it. It is known from Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1008">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-austin-tx-7-15-00-director-s-reportd1008/ austin-tx-7-15-00-director-s-report], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-austin-tx-7-15-00-director-s-reportd1008/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Jack Bauer]]
